objective: Complete the Floor 04 pre-training audit and harden the F03→F04→F05 media execution boundary without changing the locked parallel floor topology or authority hierarchy.

rulesConsidered: F03 and F04 remain parallel predecessors of F05.
Guardian authorizes worker execution; workers cannot self-authorize.
F03 remains provider-neutral planning; F04 owns physical media realization.
F07 remains final physical/semantic verification authority.
External research is evidence, not architecture authority.

forensicFindings: Deterministic F04 workers previously emitted shallow synthetic byte stubs that could satisfy magic-byte checks without proving true physical dimensions/duration.
F04 handoff lineage did not require the exact F03 AssetPlanIR fingerprint.
Media registry writes were not atomic.
Crash reconciliation removed ambiguous staging artifacts instead of preserving forensic evidence.
F04 provider selection was not isolated behind an explicit allowlist seam.
F05 join validation did not confirm the exact F03 plan fingerprint carried through F04.
F03 handoff allowed missing AssetPlanIR even though F04 requires it.
changes: Added exact F03 AssetPlanIR fingerprint binding to F04 physical assets and handoff.
Replaced fake image bytes with standards-valid deterministic PNG output.
Replaced fake TTS/background-audio bytes with real deterministic WAV output.
Added actual PNG dimension and WAV/MP3 duration validation.
Made media registry atomic and checksum-identity-safe.
Made transaction journal atomic and thread-safe.
Changed ambiguous recovery to quarantine evidence and preserve safe rollback semantics.
Added F05 exact plan-lineage and timeline asset-reference checks.
Made F03 handoff AssetPlanIR/fingerprint lineage mandatory and bumped F03 to 2.3.1.
Added F04 research/adoption ledger and .okf decision filing.
Added bounded provider-registry tests and standards-aware media fixtures.
research: Wan2.2 hybrid T2V/I2V and cinematic controls

security.notes: Security assertions are backed by code-level path containment, symlink checks, provider MIME trust checks, atomic registry writes, quarantine, and Guardian allowlisting. Full repository security lanes remain the final gate.

trainingReadiness.ascalon: Bounded optimization/recommendation only; no authority promotion.
